decisions.choice: the sentence begins in 25:19: "And it was after the plague, the LORD said ..."
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verse 25:19 holds only the words "And it was after the plague", and the sentence goes on here. Many Bibles join the two and number them 26:1. This verse therefore starts in the middle of a sentence, and this book is cited by the Hebrew verse numbers. The plague is the one that ended when Phinehas acted at Peor, after 24,000 had died (25:8-9).

decisions.choice: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest: Eleazar is now the high priest
decisions.reason: Aaron died on Mount Hor, and his priestly garments were put on Eleazar (20:25-28). So "the priest" here describes Eleazar, not Aaron. Moses had taken the first census with Aaron (1:3); he takes the second with Eleazar (verse 63).

decisions.choice: lowercase start
decisions.reason: Each level begins without a capital letter because the sentence began in 25:19 (m1). Readable ends the sentence here and starts the command with "He said", as 1:1 does.

decisions.choice: passé simple for the narrative at Literal and Balanced ("dit"); passé composé at Readable ("a parlé", "il leur a dit")
decisions.reason: As in the rest of Numbers (French style guide, section 3): the passé simple is the tense of written French narrative, the passé composé that of plain Readable French. The census lists that follow are mostly verbless, and their totals follow the same split ("furent" at Balanced, "on a compté" at Readable).

decisions.choice: lowercase start, with the span's lowercase option "o SENHOR"
decisions.reason: The sentence began in 25:19 (m1), so every level starts in lowercase, as the English does; the divine-name span therefore uses its lowercase form "o SENHOR", not the sentence-start "O SENHOR". "O sacerdote" goes with Eleazar, the high priest now (m2): Readable puts it before his name so it cannot be read of Aaron.

source.text: שְׂא֞וּ אֶת־רֹ֣אשׁ׀כָּל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up [the] head of all [the] congregation of [the] sons of Israel from a son of twenty years and upward by [the] house of their fathers, every one going out [to the] army in Israel.

en.L: "Lift up the head of all the congregation of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, from a son of twenty years and upward, by the house of their fathers, every one going out [to the] army in Israel."
en.B: "Take a census of the whole congregation of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} by their ancestral families, all the men in Israel twenty years old and up, everyone who can go out to war."
en.R: "Count the whole community of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} by families. Count every man in Israel who is twenty years old or older and can go out to war."

es.L: «{{plural_you:Levanten|Levantad}} la cabeza de toda la comunidad de los hijos de Israel, desde [la edad de] veinte años en adelante, por la casa de sus padres, todo el que sale al ejército en Israel».
es.B: «{{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} un censo de toda la comunidad de los israelitas por familias: todos los hombres de Israel de veinte años o más, todos los que son aptos para salir a la guerra».
es.R: «{{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} a toda la comunidad de los israelitas por familias. {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} a todos los hombres de Israel que tengan veinte años o más y puedan ir a la guerra».

fr.L: « Levez la tête de toute la communauté des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, depuis [l’âge de] vingt ans et au-dessus, selon la maison de leurs pères, tout [homme] qui sort à l’armée en Israël. »
fr.B: « Faites le recensement de toute la communauté des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} par familles : tous les hommes d’Israël âgés de vingt ans et plus, tous ceux qui peuvent partir à la guerre. »
fr.R: « Comptez toute la communauté des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} par familles. Comptez tous les hommes d’Israël qui ont vingt ans ou plus et qui peuvent partir à la guerre. »

sw.L: "Inueni kichwa cha jumuiya yote ya wana wa Israeli, kuanzia mwana wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, kwa nyumba ya baba zao, kila atokaye [kwenda] jeshini katika Israeli."
sw.B: "Fanyeni hesabu ya jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli kwa jamaa zao: wanaume wote wa Israeli wenye umri wa miaka ishirini na zaidi, kila mmoja anayefaa kwenda vitani."
sw.R: "Hesabuni jumuiya yote ya Waisraeli kwa jamaa. Hesabuni kila mwanamume katika Israeli mwenye miaka ishirini au zaidi anayeweza kwenda vitani."

vi.L: "Hãy tính đầu người toàn thể hội chúng con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ [người] hai mươi tuổi trở lên, theo nhà cha họ, mọi người đi ra [nhập] quân đội trong Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: "Hãy kiểm tra dân số toàn thể hội chúng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên theo từng gia đình, mọi người nam trong Y-sơ-ra-ên từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên, tức là mọi người có thể ra trận."
vi.R: "Hãy đếm toàn thể cộng đồng dân Y-sơ-ra-ên theo từng gia đình. Hãy đếm mọi người nam trong Y-sơ-ra-ên từ hai mươi tuổi trở lên có thể ra trận."

ko.L: "이스라엘 자손 온 회중의 머릿수를 세되, 스무 살 된 아들부터 그 이상으로, 그들의 조상의 집대로, 이스라엘에서 군대에 나가는 모든 자를 [세어라]."
ko.B: "이스라엘 백성의 온 회중을 조상의 집안별로 인구 조사하여라. 이스라엘에서 스무 살 이상으로 전쟁에 나갈 수 있는 모든 남자를 세어라."
ko.R: "이스라엘 사람들의 온 회중을 집안별로 세어라. 이스라엘에서 스무 살 이상으로 전쟁에 나갈 수 있는 남자를 모두 세어야 한다."

pt.L: "Levantem a cabeça de toda a comunidade dos filhos de Israel, de vinte anos para cima, segundo as suas famílias, todo o que sai [para o] exército em Israel."
pt.B: "Façam o recenseamento de toda a comunidade dos israelitas por famílias, todos os homens de Israel de vinte anos para cima, aptos para a guerra."
pt.R: "Contem toda a comunidade dos israelitas por famílias. Contem todos os homens de Israel que têm vinte anos ou mais e podem ir à guerra."

decisions.choice: lift up the head: take a census, as in 1:2
decisions.reason: The command repeats the words of the first census almost exactly (1:2-3). Nearly forty years later (14:33-34), the people who were counted then have died in the wilderness (verses 64-65), and a new generation is counted before it enters the land.

decisions.choice: every one going out to the army: every man fit for military service
decisions.reason: As in 1:3, the count is of men able to fight. This count also serves a second purpose: the land is to be divided by its numbers (verses 53-54).

decisions.choice: all the men / every man
decisions.reason: As in 1:3: those counted are males, so Balanced and Readable say "men". "House of their fathers" is "ancestral families" at Balanced and "families" at Readable, as in 1:2.

decisions.choice: "Hãy tính đầu người" (lift up the head) at Literal; "kiểm tra dân số" (Balanced), "đếm" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese Numbers 1:2 renders the same idiom for a census; enrolment is "kiểm kê" (Literal, Balanced) and "đếm" (Readable) through the chapter, as there.

decisions.choice: "머릿수를 세다" (L), "인구 조사하다" (B), "세다" (R) for lifting up the head, as Numbers 1:2 in Korean
decisions.reason: The second census uses the same idiom as the first, so the Korean follows the wording of Numbers 1.

decisions.choice: Levantem a cabeça (L); Façam o recenseamento (B); Contem (R); todo o que sai [para o] exército (L), aptos para a guerra (B), podem ir à guerra (R)
decisions.reason: The command repeats the census of 1:2-3 (m1, m2), so each level uses the Portuguese wording set there: the idiom at Literal, "fazer o recenseamento" and "aptos para a guerra" at Balanced, "contar" and "ir à guerra" at Readable. The verbs are "vocês" forms, since the LORD speaks to Moses and Eleazar together (verse 1).

decisions.choice: the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho: Israel's last camp before the land
decisions.reason: The plains are the low land east of the Jordan, north of the Dead Sea, facing Jericho on the other side of the river. Israel camped there from 22:1 to the end of the book, and Deuteronomy is set there too (Deuteronomy 1:1-5; 34:1).

decisions.choice: spoke with them: with the people to be counted
decisions.reason: "Them" has no name in the sentence. It most likely means the Israelites of verse 2, or their leaders, who carried out the command.

decisions.choice: the people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the people for the bare "them" (m2), and "across from" Jericho, since the city lay on the far side of the river.

decisions.choice: nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão [de] Jericó (L); junto ao Jordão, em frente a Jericó (B, R)
decisions.reason: The low land east of the Jordan facing Jericho (m1) is "as planícies de Moabe", the plain Portuguese word; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "Jordan of Jericho" with the preposition in brackets, and Balanced and Readable say "em frente a Jericó", since the city lay across the river, as the English says "across from". Verse 63 repeats the same words.

decisions.choice: from twenty years old: a shortened command
decisions.reason: The words of Moses and Eleazar are given only in brief, with no verb: "from twenty years and upward". They stand for the whole command of verse 2.

decisions.choice: and the sons of Israel who came out of Egypt: the heading of the list that follows
alternatives: as the LORD commanded Moses and the Israelites who came out of the land of Egypt
decisions.reason: The words can be read with what comes before, "as the LORD commanded Moses and the Israelites who came out of Egypt", or as the heading of the list in verses 5-51, "the Israelites who came out of Egypt were these". The accents in the Hebrew text set the words apart from "Moses", and verse 5 begins the list with no other heading, so the second reading is followed. Those counted are the people of the exodus as a whole, though most of these men were born in the wilderness or were children when Israel left Egypt (verses 64-65).

decisions.choice: of Pallu, the clan of the Palluites: each clan named after a forefather
decisions.reason: Each line of the list names a forefather and the clan that bears his name: "belonging to Pallu, the clan of the Palluite". The clan name is singular in form but means the whole group, "the Palluites". Here, unlike chapter 1, the tribes are counted clan by clan. The clan names follow the list of Jacob's family who went down to Egypt (Genesis 46:8-27), with some differences in spelling and order.

decisions.choice: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: the list begins with him as in 1:20
decisions.reason: Reuben was Jacob's oldest son (Genesis 29:32). His four clans are the four sons named in Genesis 46:9 and Exodus 6:14. The tribes come in the order of 1:20-43, except that Manasseh comes before Ephraim (verse 28).

decisions.choice: from Hanoch, the clan of ... / Hanoch's clan
decisions.reason: Balanced says "from" the forefather, since the clan descends from him; Readable puts it as "Hanoch's clan, the Hanochites". The same pattern is kept through the list.

decisions.choice: "el clan de los hanoquitas", "el clan de los faluitas": each clan name is the Spanish form of the forefather's name (as in Genesis 46) + "-itas", lowercase like other gentilics; the final vowel drops, c becomes qu (Hanoc, hanoquitas), a final -a takes "-aítas" (Tola, tolaítas); where the Hebrew clan name differs from the forefather's (selanitas, funitas, sufamitas, naamitas) it is built on the clan name, as in English
decisions.reason: One pattern for the whole chapter, as "los gersonitas", "los libnitas" in chapter 3. The Spanish forms keep the traditional F for Hebrew p where Genesis 46 has it (Falú, faluitas; Fares, faresitas; Fúa, funitas).

decisions.choice: "le clan des Hanokites", "le clan des Pallouites": each clan name is the French form of the forefather's name (as in Genesis 46) + "-ites", capitalised; a final -i drops (Karmi, Karmites), a final -a takes "-ïtes" (Tola, Tolaïtes); where the Hebrew clan name differs from the forefather's (Shelanites, Punites, Shuphamites, Naamites) it is built on the clan name, as in English
decisions.reason: One pattern for the whole chapter, as "les Guershonites", "les Libnites" in chapter 3. "Clan" is the settled word for mishpachah; the names of the forefathers are those already used for Jacob's family in Genesis 46.

decisions.choice: "ukoo wa Wahanoki", "ukoo wa Wapalu": each clan name is "Wa-" + the Swahili form of the forefather's name as in Genesis 46 (Hanoki, Wahanoki; Palu, Wapalu); where the Hebrew clan name differs from the forefather's (Washelani, Wapuni, Washufamu, Wanaami) it is built on the clan name, as in English
decisions.reason: One pattern for the whole chapter, as "Wagershoni", "Walibni" in chapter 3: the class 2 prefix Wa- names the people descended from a man, as Waisraeli from Israeli.

decisions.choice: "của Hê-nóc, gia tộc Hê-nóc" (Literal), "từ Hê-nóc có gia tộc Hê-nóc" (Balanced), "gia tộc Hê-nóc, ra từ Hê-nóc" (Readable) for "of Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochites"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese has no clan ending like English -ite: the clan is named after its ancestor ("gia tộc Líp-ni", as the Vietnamese Numbers 3:21). Where the Hebrew clan name differs from the ancestor's (Punites, Shuphamites), the clan form is kept. The same pattern runs through the chapter.

decisions.choice: Names as the Vietnamese Genesis 46, Exodus 6, Joshua 17 and 1 Chronicles spell them (Hê-nóc, Pha-lu, Hết-rôn, Cạt-mi; Thô-la, Phu-va; Mách-la, Nô-a, Hốt-la, Minh-ca, Thiệt-sa ...)
decisions.reason: Kept the same through the Bible so the lists can be compared; names found in no earlier Vietnamese book (Xê-phôn, Óc-ni, A-rốt, I-ê-xe, Ê-ran, A-hi-ram, Sê-phu-pham, Hu-pham, Su-cham) follow the usual Protestant transliteration.

decisions.choice: The clan list as Numbers 3 in Korean: "X에게서 [난] X 사람들의 가문" (L), "X에게서 난 X 가문" (B), "X 가문" (R); totals in figures
decisions.reason: "가문" is the term sheet's word for the clan (mishpachah); Readable drops the repeated ancestor where the clan bears his name, as the English Readable shortens the formula. Recorded once for the census.

decisions.choice: o clã dos hanoquitas, dos paluítas ...: the clan names in "-itas", lowercase, formed on the forefather's Portuguese name
decisions.reason: For the whole book. Each clan is named after its forefather (m1); Portuguese forms the clan name with "-ita", lowercase, as it does for "os levitas", "os israelitas" and the Levite clans of 3:21, on the name as Genesis 46:8-27 spells it in Portuguese: Hanoque, hanoquitas; Palu, paluítas; Hezrom, hezronitas; Carmi, carmitas; Nemuel, Jamim, Jaquim, Zerá, Saul (nemuelitas, jaminitas, jaquinitas, zeraítas, saulitas); Zefom, Hagi, Suni, Ozni, Eri, Arode, Areli; Selá (selanitas, from the Hebrew form of the clan name), Perez, Hamul; Tola, Puva (punitas), Jasube, Sinrom; Serede, Elom, Jaleel; Maquir, Gileade, Iezer, Heleque, Asriel, Siquém, Semida, Hefer; Sutela, Bequer, Taã, Erã; Belá, Asbel, Airã, Sefufã (sufamitas), Hufã, Arde, Naamã; Suã; Imna, Isvi, Berias (beriítas), Héber, Malquiel; Jazeel, Guni, Jezer, Silém. Where the forefather's name ends in a stressed vowel, the "i" of the ending takes an accent to show the hiatus (paluítas, zeraítas, tolaítas). Readable says "o clã de Hanoque, os hanoquitas", as the English Readable says "Hanoch's clan, the Hanochites"; the same patterns run through verse 50.

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Eliab: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram; that [is] Dathan and Abiram, called [ones] of the congregation who struggled against Moses and against Aaron in [the] company of Korah when they struggled against Yahweh.

en.L: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. That [is] the Dathan and Abiram, called [ones] of the congregation, who struggled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they struggled against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram, men chosen from the congregation, who fought against Moses and Aaron with Korah's company when they fought against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Eliab's sons were Nemuel, Dathan and Abiram. These were the Dathan and Abiram who were leaders chosen by the community. They joined Korah's followers and rebelled against Moses and Aaron. They were really rebelling against {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.B: Los hijos de Eliab fueron Nemuel, Datán y Abiram. Estos son los mismos Datán y Abiram, hombres escogidos de la comunidad, que se enfrentaron a Moisés y a Aarón con el grupo de Coré cuando se enfrentaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Và các con trai Ê-li-áp: Nê-mu-ên, Đa-than và A-bi-ram. Đó [là] Đa-than và A-bi-ram, những người được triệu tập của hội chúng, là những người đã tranh chiến chống Môi-se và chống A-rôn trong bè đảng Cô-rê, khi họ tranh chiến chống {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các con trai Ê-li-áp là Nê-mu-ên, Đa-than và A-bi-ram. Đây chính là Đa-than và A-bi-ram, những người được chọn từ hội chúng, đã cùng bè đảng Cô-rê chống lại Môi-se và A-rôn khi họ chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các con trai Ê-li-áp là Nê-mu-ên, Đa-than và A-bi-ram. Đa-than và A-bi-ram này là những người lãnh đạo được cộng đồng chọn. Họ đã theo phe Cô-rê và nổi loạn chống lại Môi-se và A-rôn. Thật ra họ đã nổi loạn chống lại {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 엘리압의 아들들은 느무엘과 다단과 아비람[이다]. 이 다단과 아비람은 회중에서 부름받은 자들로, 고라의 무리에 끼어 모세와 아론에게 맞서 다투었는데, 그때 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 맞서 다툰 것이다.
ko.B: 엘리압의 아들들은 느무엘과 다단과 아비람이었다. 이 다단과 아비람은 회중 가운데서 뽑힌 사람들이었는데, 고라의 무리와 함께 모세와 아론에게 대들었다. 그것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 대든 것이었다.
ko.R: 엘리압의 아들들은 느무엘과 다단과 아비람이었다. 이 다단과 아비람은 회중이 뽑은 지도자들이었다. 그들은 고라를 따르는 무리와 함께 모세와 아론에게 반역하였다. 그것은 사실 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 반역한 것이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Eliabe: Nemuel, e Datã, e Abirão. Estes [são] o Datã e o Abirão, chamados da comunidade, que lutaram contra Moisés e contra Arão no grupo de Corá, quando lutaram contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Os filhos de Eliabe foram Nemuel, Datã e Abirão. Esses são os mesmos Datã e Abirão, homens escolhidos da comunidade, que lutaram contra Moisés e Arão junto com o grupo de Corá, quando lutaram contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Os filhos de Eliabe foram Nemuel, Datã e Abirão. Esses foram o Datã e o Abirão que eram líderes escolhidos pela comunidade. Eles se juntaram aos seguidores de Corá e se revoltaram contra Moisés e Arão. Na verdade, eles estavam se revoltando contra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: that is the Dathan and Abiram: the rebels of chapter 16
decisions.reason: The list stops to point out two well-known names. Dathan and Abiram, Reubenites, rose up with Korah against Moses and were swallowed by the earth (16:1-33). This Nemuel is a brother of theirs, not the Simeonite clan of verse 12.

decisions.choice: called ones: the marginal reading
decisions.reason: As in 1:16, the written Hebrew spells this word slightly differently, and the Masoretes' marginal reading gives the usual form of "called ones". The meaning is the same: men summoned to act for the people (1:16; 16:2).

decisions.choice: struggled against: fought, contended
decisions.reason: The verb means to struggle or fight, as two men fight in Exodus 2:13. Their quarrel with Moses and Aaron was a quarrel with the LORD who had appointed them (16:11).

decisions.choice: company / followers
decisions.reason: Korah's band is "company" at Literal and Balanced and "followers" at Readable, as in 16-17.

decisions.choice: They were really rebelling against the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable gives the last clause its own sentence and says what it means: in fighting Moses and Aaron they were fighting the LORD.

decisions.choice: Datã, Abirão, Corá; o grupo de Corá (L, B), os seguidores de Corá (R)
decisions.reason: The rebels of chapter 16 (m1) keep their usual Brazilian names, "Datã" and "Abirão", and "Corá" as Exodus 6:21 spells it. Korah's band is "o grupo de Corá" at Literal and Balanced: "companhia" reads as a business or a military unit, and "bando" would add a judgement the word does not carry; Readable says "os seguidores", as the English Readable does. Literal keeps the article before the names ("o Datã e o Abirão") to show the Hebrew's "that is the Dathan and Abiram" already known.

records.literal_gloss: And opened the earth its mouth and swallowed them and Korah, at [the] death of the company, when consumed the fire fifty and two hundred man, and they became a warning sign.

en.L: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah, when the company died, when the fire consumed 250 men; and they became a warning sign.
en.B: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them along with Korah, when his company died and the fire devoured 250 men. They became a warning.
en.R: The ground opened like a mouth and swallowed them and Korah. His followers died, and fire burned up 250 men. What happened to them was a warning to the people.

es.L: Y abrió la tierra su boca y se los tragó a ellos y a Coré, cuando murió el grupo, cuando el fuego consumió a 250 hombres; y se convirtieron en señal de advertencia.
es.B: La tierra abrió su boca y se los tragó junto con Coré, cuando murió su grupo y el fuego devoró a 250 hombres. Se convirtieron en una advertencia.
es.R: El suelo se abrió como una boca y se los tragó a ellos y a Coré. Sus seguidores murieron, y el fuego quemó a 250 hombres. Lo que les pasó fue una advertencia para el pueblo.

fr.L: Et la terre ouvrit sa bouche et les engloutit, ainsi que Coré, quand la bande mourut, quand le feu dévora 250 hommes ; et ils devinrent un signe d’avertissement.
fr.B: La terre ouvrit sa bouche et les engloutit avec Coré, lorsque sa bande périt et que le feu dévora 250 hommes. Ils devinrent un avertissement.
fr.R: Le sol s’est ouvert comme une bouche et les a avalés, avec Coré. Ses partisans sont morts, et le feu a brûlé 250 hommes. Ce qui leur est arrivé a servi d’avertissement au peuple.

sw.L: Na nchi ikafungua kinywa chake ikawameza wao pamoja na Kora, kundi lile lilipokufa, moto ulipowateketeza watu 250; nao wakawa ishara ya onyo.
sw.B: Nchi ilifungua kinywa chake ikawameza pamoja na Kora, wakati kundi lake lilipokufa na moto ukawateketeza watu 250. Wakawa onyo.

vi.L: Và đất hả miệng ra và nuốt họ cùng với Cô-rê, khi bè đảng ấy chết, khi lửa thiêu nuốt 250 người; và họ trở thành một dấu hiệu cảnh cáo.
vi.B: Đất hả miệng ra nuốt họ cùng với Cô-rê, khi bè đảng của ông chết và lửa thiêu nuốt 250 người. Họ đã trở thành một lời cảnh cáo.
vi.R: Mặt đất mở ra như một cái miệng và nuốt họ cùng với Cô-rê. Những người theo Cô-rê đều chết, và lửa thiêu chết 250 người. Điều xảy ra cho họ là một lời cảnh cáo cho dân chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 땅이 그 입을 벌려 그들과 고라를 삼켰다. 그 무리가 죽을 때, 불이 250명을 삼켰을 때였다. 그리고 그들은 경고의 표가 되었다.
ko.B: 땅이 입을 벌려 그들을 고라와 함께 삼켜 버렸다. 그때 고라의 무리가 죽었고, 불이 250명을 삼켰다. 그들은 경고의 표가 되었다.
ko.R: 땅이 입처럼 벌어져 그들과 고라를 삼켰다. 고라를 따르던 사람들도 죽었고, 불이 250명을 태워 버렸다. 그들에게 일어난 일은 백성에게 경고가 되었다.

pt.L: E a terra abriu a sua boca e os engoliu, e a Corá, quando morreu o grupo, quando o fogo consumiu 250 homens; e eles se tornaram um sinal de advertência.
pt.B: A terra abriu a boca e os engoliu junto com Corá, quando o grupo dele morreu e o fogo devorou 250 homens. Eles se tornaram uma advertência.
pt.R: O chão se abriu como uma boca e engoliu Datã, Abirão e Corá. Os seguidores de Corá morreram, e o fogo queimou 250 homens. O que aconteceu com eles foi um aviso para o povo.

decisions.choice: the earth swallowed them, and the fire consumed 250 men: the two judgments of chapter 16
decisions.reason: The verse sums up 16:31-35: the ground split open under Dathan and Abiram and their households, and fire from the LORD consumed the 250 men offering incense. Here Korah is named with those the earth swallowed (16:32).

decisions.choice: a sign: a warning set up for all to see
decisions.reason: The word means a banner or signal pole raised high, as the pole of the bronze serpent (21:8-9). Here the dead men themselves became a signal to Israel, as the censers made into plating for the altar were a sign (17:3).

decisions.choice: The ground opened like a mouth
decisions.reason: Readable turns the picture of the earth's mouth into a comparison, as in 16:32.

decisions.choice: engoliu Datã, Abirão e Corá (R)
decisions.reason: Readable names the two men for the bare "them", since its short sentences have put verse 9 out of sight; the English Readable keeps "them". "Sinal de advertência" (L) and "advertência" (B) give the sense of m2; Readable says "aviso", the everyday word.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah did not die: Korah's line went on
decisions.reason: Korah's household is said to have been swallowed (16:32), but his sons were spared. Their clan is counted among the Levites (verse 58), and the Korahites later served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Several psalms are headed "of the sons of Korah" (Psalms 42; 44-49).

decisions.choice: and: here "but"
decisions.reason: The word "and" sets this fact against verse 10: the fathers died, the sons lived.

decisions.choice: Nemuel, Jamin, Jachin: Simeon's sons
decisions.reason: Genesis 46:10 and Exodus 6:15 name Simeon's sons Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar and Shaul. Nemuel is another form of Jemuel, as Zerah (verse 13) is of Zohar. Ohad has no clan here.

decisions.choice: by their clans: each tribe now listed clan by clan
decisions.reason: From here on each tribe's list opens with "by their clans" and closes with a total, as in verse 7.

decisions.choice: the heading of each tribe's list
decisions.reason: Each tribe's list opens with the same words at each level: "The sons of ... by their clans" (Literal), "The descendants of ... by their clans" (Balanced), "These are the clans of ...'s descendants" (Readable).

decisions.choice: Os filhos de ... segundo os seus clãs (L); Os descendentes de ..., segundo os seus clãs (B); Estes são os clãs dos descendentes de ... (R)
decisions.reason: For the chapter: each tribe's list opens with the same words at each level, as the English does (r-en-1); "segundo os seus clãs" is the wording of 1:20 and 3:18 in Portuguese. Simeon's Nemuel is spelled as Eliab's son in verse 9; Genesis 46:10 calls him Jemuel.

decisions.reason: As in verse 12. Literal shows that Tola, like Hanoch in verse 5, stands without "of".

decisions.choice: "los funitas" for the clan of Puvah (Fúa)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew clan name is "Punite", not built on the form "Puvah" (m1). Spanish keeps the F of its traditional form of the forefather's name, Fúa (Genesis 46:13), so the clan is "funitas", as "faluitas" from Falú and "faresitas" from Fares.

decisions.choice: Puva ... os punitas
decisions.reason: The clan name is formed differently from the forefather's name in the Hebrew (m1), so Portuguese keeps the difference, as the English does: "Puva", the form of Genesis 46:13, and "os punitas". Verse 24's "Jasube" is the name Genesis 46:13 gives as Jobe.

decisions.choice: Manasseh and Ephraim: here the older son comes first
decisions.reason: Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn (Genesis 41:51-52), but Jacob put Ephraim first (Genesis 48:14-20), and chapters 1, 2 and 7 list Ephraim before Manasseh. Here the order of birth is kept. The text does not say why; Manasseh is now the larger tribe (verses 34, 37).

decisions.choice: Machir and Gilead: father and son, and later the names of lands east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Machir was Manasseh's son (Genesis 50:23), and Gilead his son. The Machirites later take the region of Gilead east of the Jordan (32:39-40), and the name Gilead is used both of the man and of the land.

decisions.choice: fathered: became the father of
decisions.reason: The verb is the causative form of "bear" used for a father in family lists (Genesis 5:3-32). Manasseh's tribe is traced through two steps, Machir and then Gilead, before its clans are named (verses 30-32).

decisions.choice: Machir was Gilead's father.
decisions.reason: Readable names both clans first and puts the family note in its own sentence.

decisions.choice: gerou (L); foi o pai de (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal says "gerou", the Portuguese word for a father begetting a son (m2), as the genealogies of Genesis do; Balanced and Readable say "foi o pai de", as the English does.

decisions.reason: Hepher's clan is named last because the next verse turns to his son Zelophehad, whose daughters bring their case to Moses in 27:1-11.

source.text: וּצְלָפְחָ֣ד בֶּן־חֵ֗פֶר לֹא־הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־בָּנ֑וֹת וְשֵׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֔ד מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃

sw.R: Selofehadi mwana wa Heferi hakuwa na watoto wa kiume. Alikuwa na binti tu. Majina yao yalikuwa Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milka na Tirsa.

vi.L: Và Xê-lô-phát con trai Hê-phe không có con trai, chỉ có con gái; và tên các con gái Xê-lô-phát [là] Mách-la và Nô-a, Hốt-la, Minh-ca và Thiệt-sa.

ko.L: 그리고 헤벨의 아들 슬로브핫에게는 아들이 없고 딸들뿐이었다. 그리고 슬로브핫의 딸들의 이름은 말라와 노아, 호글라, 밀가와 디르사[였다].
ko.B: 헤벨의 아들 슬로브핫은 아들이 없고 딸들만 있었다. 슬로브핫의 딸들의 이름은 말라, 노아, 호글라, 밀가, 디르사였다.
ko.R: 헤벨의 아들 슬로브핫에게는 아들이 없었다. 그에게는 딸들만 있었다. 그 딸들의 이름은 말라, 노아, 호글라, 밀가, 디르사였다.

pt.L: E Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, não teve filhos, mas somente filhas; e os nomes das filhas de Zelofeade [eram] Maalá e Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.
pt.B: Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, não teve filhos homens, só filhas. Os nomes das filhas de Zelofeade eram Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.
pt.R: Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, não teve nenhum filho homem. Ele só teve filhas. Os nomes delas eram Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.

decisions.choice: Zelophehad had no sons, only daughters: the case of 27:1-11 and 36:1-12
decisions.reason: The census was taken to divide the land among the clans (verses 53-55). A man with no sons would have no share in it, so his daughters come to Moses to ask for their father's inheritance (27:1-11). Their names are given again in 27:1 and 36:11, and they receive land in Joshua 17:3-6.

decisions.choice: there were not to him sons except daughters
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "there were not to him sons, but daughters". The words "but" after a negative mean "only".

decisions.choice: Noah: a woman's name, not the Noah of the flood
decisions.reason: This name is spelled differently in Hebrew from the name of Noah in Genesis 6-9, and probably means "movement". The two names look alike only in translation.

decisions.choice: "Noa" for Zelophehad's daughter; "hijos varones" at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: Her Hebrew name is not that of Noah of the flood ("Noé"). Spanish "hijos" can include daughters, so Balanced and Readable say "hijos varones"; Literal keeps "hijos", which "sino solo hijas" makes clear.

decisions.choice: "Noa" for Zelophehad's daughter
decisions.reason: Her Hebrew name is not that of Noah of the flood ("Noé"); "Noa" keeps the two apart, as the English spelling cannot.

decisions.choice: "Noa" for Zelophehad's daughter; "wana wa kiume" (sons)
decisions.reason: Her Hebrew name is not that of Noah of the flood ("Nuhu"). "Wana" alone can mean children of either sex, so Swahili says "wana wa kiume", "watoto wa kiume" at Readable.

decisions.choice: Zelofeade; Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca, Tirza
decisions.reason: For the whole book (27:1; 36:11): the usual Brazilian forms, with "f" for ph and "-á" for the final -ah. The second daughter is "Noa", a woman's name, which Portuguese keeps apart from "Noé" of the flood (m3), as the Hebrew names differ.

decisions.choice: filhos homens (B, R); filhos (L)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "filhos" can include daughters, so "não teve filhos, mas somente filhas" can read as a contradiction at a glance. Balanced and Readable say "filhos homens", the plain Brazilian way to say "sons"; Literal keeps the Hebrew's "sons ... only daughters" (m2), where the contrast makes the sense clear.

pt.L: Estes [são] os clãs de Manassés, e os recenseados deles [foram] 52.700.

pt.R: Esses foram os clãs de Manassés. Deles foram contados 52.700 homens.

decisions.choice: 52,700: the total for Manasseh
decisions.reason: As in verse 7; on the size of the numbers, see the note at 1:21. Manasseh had only 32,200 in the first census (1:35), the largest gain of any tribe.

decisions.choice: Shuthelah, Becher, Tahan: the clans of Ephraim
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 7:20-27 traces a line of Ephraim from Shuthelah that leads down to Joshua son of Nun. This Becher is not Benjamin's son of the same name (Genesis 46:21), who has no clan in Benjamin's list here (verses 38-40).

decisions.reason: Eran's clan descends from Shuthelah, as Gilead's clans descend from Machir (verses 29-30). So a tribe's clans could branch out over the generations.

decisions.choice: 601,730: almost the same as the first census
decisions.reason: The twelve totals of this chapter add up to exactly this number. The first census gave 603,550 (1:46), so after nearly forty years in the wilderness Israel is only 1,820 men fewer. A whole generation has died (verses 64-65), and yet the people have not been destroyed, as the LORD had threatened in 14:12. On the size of these numbers, see the note at 1:21.
The Hebrew writes "six hundred thousand and a thousand, seven hundred and thirty". All three levels give it in figures, as in 1:46.

decisions.reason: A new speech begins. Having counted the people, the LORD tells Moses what the count is for: the division of the land (verses 53-56).

records.literal_gloss: To these will be divided the land in inheritance by [the] number of names.

en.L: "To these the land shall be divided as an inheritance by the number of names.
en.B: "The land is to be divided among these as their inheritance, according to the number of names.
en.R: "Divide the land among these tribes as their inheritance. Give it out by the number of names on the list.

es.L: «A estos se repartirá la tierra en herencia según el número de los nombres.
es.B: «La tierra se repartirá entre estos como herencia, según el número de los nombres.
es.R: «Reparte la tierra entre estas tribus como herencia. Dale a cada una su parte según el número de nombres de la lista.

fr.L: « À ceux-ci le pays sera partagé en héritage selon le nombre des noms.
fr.B: « Le pays sera partagé entre eux comme héritage, selon le nombre des noms.
fr.R: « Partage le pays entre ces tribus pour qu’il soit leur héritage. Donne à chacune sa part selon le nombre de noms sur la liste.

sw.B: "Nchi itagawanywa kati ya hawa kuwa urithi wao, kulingana na hesabu ya majina.
sw.R: "Gawa nchi kati ya makabila haya kuwa urithi wao. Igawe kulingana na idadi ya majina yaliyo kwenye orodha.

vi.B: "Đất phải được chia cho những người này làm sản nghiệp, theo số tên đã được ghi.
vi.R: "Hãy chia đất cho các chi tộc này làm sản nghiệp. Hãy chia theo số tên có trong danh sách.

ko.L: "이들에게 그 땅이 이름의 수대로 유산으로 나누어질 것이다.
ko.B: "이 사람들에게 이름의 수에 따라 땅을 나누어 유산으로 주어야 한다.

pt.L: "A estes será repartida a terra em herança, segundo o número de nomes.
pt.B: "A terra será repartida entre estes como herança, de acordo com o número de nomes.
pt.R: "Divide a terra entre essas tribos como herança. Dá a cada uma uma parte de acordo com o número de nomes da lista.

decisions.choice: inheritance: land held by a family and passed down
decisions.reason: The word means a share of property that belongs to a family or tribe for good and passes from father to son. The land is the LORD's gift, and each tribe's share is its lasting possession (Leviticus 25:23; Numbers 36:7).

decisions.choice: by the number of names: by the count just taken
decisions.reason: The "names" are the men listed in the census (verse 2; 1:2). The size of each tribe's share is to follow its count.

decisions.choice: these tribes
decisions.reason: Readable says "tribes", since "these" means the tribes just counted.

decisions.choice: "유산" for the inheritance of land
decisions.reason: As the other chapters of Numbers in Korean (27, 33-36); "기업" is the older church word, which today means a business.

decisions.choice: a herança (every level)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the word is a family's or a tribe's share of land, held for good and handed down (m1). "Herança" says both, and keeps the link with "herdar" (verse 55) and "o direito de herança" (27:11); the English Readable keeps "inheritance" here, and so does Portuguese.

decisions.choice: tu (Divide, Dá) (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks to Moses alone (verse 52), so where Readable turns the passive into a command, as the English Readable does, it uses "tu"; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew passive.

source.text: לָרַ֗ב תַּרְבֶּה֙ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ וְלַמְעַ֕ט תַּמְעִ֖יט נַחֲלָת֑וֹ אִ֚ישׁ לְפִ֣י פְקֻדָ֔יו יֻתַּ֖ן נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To the many you will make great its inheritance, and to the few you will make small its inheritance; each according to [the] mouth of his enrolled will be given his inheritance.

en.L: To the many you shall make its inheritance great, and to the few you shall make its inheritance small; each according to the mouth of his enrolled shall his inheritance be given.
en.B: To a large tribe you are to give a larger inheritance, and to a small tribe a smaller one. Each is to be given its inheritance according to the number of those enrolled in it.
en.R: Give a large tribe more land, and a small tribe less land. Each tribe will get land by the number of men counted in it.

es.L: Al numeroso le agrandarás su herencia, y al escaso le reducirás su herencia; a cada uno se le dará su herencia conforme a la boca de sus alistados.
es.B: A una tribu grande le darás una herencia mayor, y a una tribu pequeña, una menor. A cada una se le dará su herencia según el número de sus alistados.
es.R: Dale más tierra a una tribu grande, y menos tierra a una tribu pequeña. Cada tribu recibirá tierra según el número de hombres contados en ella.

fr.L: Au grand nombre tu agrandiras son héritage, et au petit nombre tu réduiras son héritage ; à chacun sera donné son héritage selon la bouche de ses recensés.
fr.B: À une tribu nombreuse tu donneras un héritage plus grand, et à une petite tribu un héritage plus petit. Chacune recevra son héritage selon le nombre de ses recensés.
fr.R: Donne plus de terre à une grande tribu, et moins de terre à une petite tribu. Chaque tribu recevra de la terre selon le nombre d’hommes qu’on y a comptés.

sw.L: Kwa walio wengi utaongeza urithi wao, na kwa walio wachache utapunguza urithi wao; kila mmoja atapewa urithi wake kwa kadiri ya kinywa cha walioandikishwa wake.
sw.B: Kwa kabila kubwa utatoa urithi mkubwa zaidi, na kwa kabila dogo urithi mdogo zaidi. Kila kabila litapewa urithi wake kulingana na idadi ya walioandikishwa ndani yake.
sw.R: Lipe kabila kubwa nchi zaidi, na kabila dogo nchi kidogo. Kila kabila litapata nchi kulingana na idadi ya wanaume waliohesabiwa ndani yake.

vi.L: Cho [chi tộc] đông người ngươi sẽ cho sản nghiệp lớn, và cho [chi tộc] ít người ngươi sẽ cho sản nghiệp nhỏ; mỗi [chi tộc] sẽ được ban sản nghiệp theo miệng của những người được kiểm kê của nó.
vi.B: Chi tộc đông người thì con phải cho sản nghiệp lớn hơn, chi tộc ít người thì cho sản nghiệp nhỏ hơn. Mỗi chi tộc sẽ nhận sản nghiệp theo số người được kiểm kê trong chi tộc ấy.
vi.R: Chi tộc lớn được nhiều đất hơn, chi tộc nhỏ được ít đất hơn. Mỗi chi tộc sẽ nhận đất theo số người được đếm trong chi tộc ấy.

ko.L: 많은 [지파]에게는 그 유산을 많이 주고, 적은 [지파]에게는 그 유산을 적게 주어라. 각자에게 그 계수된 자의 입에 따라 그의 유산이 주어질 것이다.
ko.B: 큰 지파에게는 유산을 많이 주고, 작은 지파에게는 적게 주어라. 각 지파에 계수된 사람의 수에 따라 유산을 주어야 한다.
ko.R: 큰 지파에게는 땅을 많이 주고, 작은 지파에게는 땅을 적게 주어라. 각 지파는 거기서 센 사람의 수에 따라 땅을 받을 것이다.

pt.L: Ao muito tu farás grande a sua herança, e ao pouco tu farás pequena a sua herança; a cada um, segundo a boca dos seus recenseados, será dada a sua herança.
pt.B: A uma tribo grande darás uma herança maior, e a uma tribo pequena, uma menor. Cada uma receberá a sua herança de acordo com o número dos seus recenseados.
pt.R: Dá mais terra a uma tribo grande e menos terra a uma tribo pequena. Cada tribo vai receber terra de acordo com o número de homens que foram contados nela.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of his enrolled: in proportion to its count
decisions.reason: "According to the mouth of" means "in keeping with", "in proportion to". Each group's share is to match the number counted in it.

decisions.choice: the many, the few, each: the tribes
decisions.reason: The words "many" and "few" and "each" have no noun. They mean a large or small tribe, as in 33:54, where the same rule is given for the clans.

decisions.choice: tribe
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "tribe" for the bare "many" and "few" (m2).

decisions.choice: singular "tú" ("agrandarás", "darás", "dale"), with no plural_you span
decisions.reason: Here the LORD speaks to Moses alone, and the Hebrew verbs are singular, unlike the plural command of verse 2 to Moses and Eleazar.

decisions.choice: segundo a boca (L); de acordo com o número (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom "according to the mouth of" for "in proportion to" (m1), as the book keeps "pela boca" for a command (3:16); Balanced and Readable give the sense. Every level says "tu": the Hebrew verbs are singular, to Moses.

source.text: אַךְ־בְּגוֹרָ֕ל יֵחָלֵ֖ק אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ לִשְׁמ֥וֹת מַטּוֹת־אֲבֹתָ֖ם יִנְחָֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Only by lot will be divided the land; by [the] names of [the] tribes of their fathers they will inherit.

en.L: Only by lot shall the land be divided; by the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
en.B: But the land is to be divided by lot. They are to receive their inheritance by the names of their ancestral tribes.
en.R: But you must use lots to divide the land. Each tribe will receive its land under the name of its ancestor.

es.L: Solo por sorteo se repartirá la tierra; por los nombres de las tribus de sus padres heredarán.
es.B: Pero la tierra se repartirá por sorteo. Recibirán su herencia según los nombres de sus tribus ancestrales.
es.R: Pero tienes que echar suertes para repartir la tierra. Cada tribu recibirá su tierra con el nombre de su antepasado.

fr.L: Seulement, c’est par le sort que le pays sera partagé ; selon les noms des tribus de leurs pères ils hériteront.
fr.B: Mais le pays sera partagé par tirage au sort. Ils recevront leur héritage selon les noms de leurs tribus ancestrales.
fr.R: Mais tu dois tirer au sort pour partager le pays. Chaque tribu recevra sa terre sous le nom de son ancêtre.

sw.L: Ila kwa kura nchi itagawanywa; kwa majina ya makabila ya baba zao watarithi.
sw.B: Lakini nchi itagawanywa kwa kura. Watapokea urithi wao kwa majina ya makabila ya mababu zao.
sw.R: Lakini lazima utupe kura ili kugawa nchi. Kila kabila litapokea nchi yake kwa jina la babu yake.

vi.L: Chỉ bằng thăm mà đất sẽ được chia; theo tên các chi tộc của tổ phụ mình họ sẽ nhận sản nghiệp.
vi.B: Nhưng đất phải được chia bằng cách bắt thăm. Họ sẽ nhận sản nghiệp theo tên các chi tộc của tổ phụ mình.
vi.R: Nhưng phải bắt thăm để chia đất. Mỗi chi tộc sẽ nhận đất dưới tên của tổ tiên mình.

ko.L: 오직 제비를 뽑아 땅을 나누어야 한다. 그들은 자기 조상들의 지파의 이름대로 유산을 받을 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 땅은 제비를 뽑아 나누어야 한다. 그들은 조상 지파의 이름에 따라 유산을 받아야 한다.
ko.R: 그러나 땅은 제비를 뽑아서 나누어야 한다. 각 지파는 자기 조상의 이름으로 땅을 받을 것이다.

pt.L: Somente por sorte será repartida a terra; segundo os nomes das tribos dos seus pais eles herdarão.
pt.B: Mas a terra será repartida por sorteio. Eles receberão a sua herança segundo os nomes das tribos dos seus antepassados.
pt.R: Mas tu deves fazer um sorteio para dividir a terra. Cada tribo vai receber a sua terra com o nome do seu antepassado.

decisions.choice: by lot: the LORD decides where each share lies
decisions.reason: A lot was a marked stone or stick, cast or drawn to make a choice no person controlled. Israel believed the LORD decided the outcome (Proverbs 16:33). The land is later divided this way (Joshua 14:2; 18:6-10).

decisions.choice: only by lot: the size and the place of each share
alternatives: the lot decides everything, and the count only guides the size of the areas drawn
decisions.reason: The word "only" sets a limit on verse 54. Most likely the size of each share was to follow the count, while the lot fixed where each tribe's land would lie. The rule is repeated in 33:54. The text does not spell out how the two were combined.

decisions.choice: by the names of the tribes of their fathers: each tribe under its forefather's name
decisions.reason: The land is shared out by tribe, each named after one of Jacob's sons. Each portion is to stay in the tribe that receives it (36:7-9).

decisions.choice: under the name of its ancestor
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "the names of the tribes of their fathers" means.

decisions.choice: "kura" for the lot; Readable "kutupa kura" (to cast lots)
decisions.reason: "Kura" is the lot, but "kupiga kura" today means to vote, which would change the meaning. Readable says "kutupa kura", casting lots, as the English Readable says "use lots".

decisions.choice: por sorte (L); por sorteio (B); fazer um sorteio (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the word is the marked stone or stick drawn so that the LORD decides (m1). Literal says "sorte" in its old sense of "lot", as Portuguese says "lançar sortes"; Balanced and Readable say "sorteio", the plain word for drawing lots, since "por sorte" alone usually means "by luck".

source.text: עַל־פִּי֙ הַגּוֹרָ֔ל תֵּחָלֵ֖ק נַחֲלָת֑וֹ בֵּ֥ין רַ֖ב לִמְעָֽט׃ס

records.literal_gloss: According to [the] mouth of the lot will be divided its inheritance between [the] many and [the] few.

en.L: According to the mouth of the lot its inheritance shall be divided between the many and the few."
en.B: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot between the larger and the smaller tribes."
en.R: Use lots to divide the land between the large tribes and the small ones."

es.L: Conforme a la boca de la suerte se repartirá su herencia entre el numeroso y el escaso».
es.B: Cada herencia se repartirá por sorteo entre las tribus más grandes y las más pequeñas».
es.R: Echa suertes para repartir la tierra entre las tribus grandes y las pequeñas».

fr.L: Selon la bouche du sort, son héritage sera partagé entre le grand nombre et le petit nombre. »
fr.B: Chaque héritage sera partagé par tirage au sort entre les tribus plus grandes et les plus petites. »
fr.R: Tire au sort pour partager le pays entre les grandes tribus et les petites. »

sw.L: Kwa kadiri ya kinywa cha kura urithi wake utagawanywa kati ya walio wengi na walio wachache."
sw.B: Kila urithi utagawanywa kwa kura kati ya makabila makubwa na madogo."
sw.R: Tupa kura ili kugawa nchi kati ya makabila makubwa na madogo."

vi.L: Theo miệng của thăm, sản nghiệp sẽ được chia giữa [chi tộc] đông và [chi tộc] ít."
vi.B: Mỗi phần sản nghiệp phải được chia bằng cách bắt thăm giữa các chi tộc lớn và các chi tộc nhỏ."
vi.R: Hãy bắt thăm để chia đất giữa các chi tộc lớn và các chi tộc nhỏ."

ko.L: 제비의 입에 따라 많은 [지파]와 적은 [지파] 사이에 그 유산이 나누어질 것이다."
ko.B: 큰 지파든 작은 지파든 각 유산은 제비를 뽑아 나누어야 한다."
ko.R: 큰 지파와 작은 지파 사이에 땅을 나눌 때는 제비를 뽑아라."

pt.L: Segundo a boca da sorte será repartida a sua herança, entre o muito e o pouco."
pt.B: Cada herança será repartida por sorteio entre as tribos maiores e as menores."
pt.R: Usa o sorteio para dividir a terra entre as tribos grandes e as pequenas."

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of the lot: as the lot decides
decisions.reason: The lot "speaks", and its word decides each share, for large and small tribes alike (verse 55).

decisions.choice: tribes
decisions.reason: As in verse 54.

source.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֣י הַלֵּוִי֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לְגֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַגֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י לִקְהָ֕ת מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקְּהָתִ֑י לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמְּרָרִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are the] enrolled of the Levite by their clans: of Gershon, [the] clan of the Gershonite; of Kohath, [the] clan of the Kohathite; of Merari, [the] clan of the Merarite.

en.L: And these [are] the enrolled [men] of the Levites by their clans: of Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites; of Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
en.B: These were the Levites enrolled by their clans: from Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites; from Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites; and from Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
en.R: These are the Levites who were counted, by their clans: Gershon's clan, the Gershonites; Kohath's clan, the Kohathites; and Merari's clan, the Merarites.

es.L: Y estos [son] los alistados de los levitas por sus clanes: de Gersón, el clan de los gersonitas; de Coat, el clan de los coatitas; de Merari, el clan de los meraritas.
es.B: Estos fueron los levitas alistados por sus clanes: de Gersón, el clan de los gersonitas; de Coat, el clan de los coatitas; y de Merari, el clan de los meraritas.
es.R: Estos son los levitas que fueron contados, por clanes: el clan de Gersón, los gersonitas; el clan de Coat, los coatitas; y el clan de Merari, los meraritas.

fr.L: Et voici les recensés des Lévites selon leurs clans : de Guershon, le clan des Guershonites ; de Kehath, le clan des Kehathites ; de Merari, le clan des Merarites.
fr.B: Voici les Lévites recensés selon leurs clans : de Guershon, le clan des Guershonites ; de Kehath, le clan des Kehathites ; et de Merari, le clan des Merarites.
fr.R: Voici les Lévites qu’on a comptés, par clans : le clan de Guershon, les Guershonites ; le clan de Kehath, les Kehathites ; et le clan de Merari, les Merarites.

sw.L: Na hawa [ndio] walioandikishwa wa Walawi kwa koo zao: kwa Gershoni, ukoo wa Wagershoni; kwa Kohathi, ukoo wa Wakohathi; kwa Merari, ukoo wa Wamerari.
sw.B: Hawa ndio Walawi walioandikishwa kwa koo zao: kutoka kwa Gershoni, ukoo wa Wagershoni; kutoka kwa Kohathi, ukoo wa Wakohathi; na kutoka kwa Merari, ukoo wa Wamerari.
sw.R: Hawa ndio Walawi waliohesabiwa, kwa koo zao: ukoo wa Gershoni, Wagershoni; ukoo wa Kohathi, Wakohathi; na ukoo wa Merari, Wamerari.

vi.L: Và đây [là] những người được kiểm kê của người Lê-vi theo gia tộc của họ: của Ghẹt-sôn, gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn; của Kê-hát, gia tộc Kê-hát; của Mê-ra-ri, gia tộc Mê-ra-ri.
vi.B: Đây là những người Lê-vi được kiểm kê theo từng gia tộc: từ Ghẹt-sôn có gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn; từ Kê-hát có gia tộc Kê-hát; và từ Mê-ra-ri có gia tộc Mê-ra-ri.
vi.R: Đây là những người Lê-vi được đếm, theo từng gia tộc: gia tộc Ghẹt-sôn, ra từ Ghẹt-sôn; gia tộc Kê-hát, ra từ Kê-hát; và gia tộc Mê-ra-ri, ra từ Mê-ra-ri.

ko.L: 그리고 이들이 그들의 가문대로 계수된 레위인이다. 게르손에게서 [난] 게르손 사람들의 가문, 그핫에게서 [난] 그핫 사람들의 가문, 므라리에게서 [난] 므라리 사람들의 가문.
ko.B: 가문별로 계수된 레위인은 이러하다. 게르손에게서 난 게르손 가문, 그핫에게서 난 그핫 가문, 므라리에게서 난 므라리 가문이다.
ko.R: 가문별로 센 레위인은 이러하다. 게르손 가문, 그핫 가문, 므라리 가문이다.

pt.L: E estes [são] os recenseados dos levitas segundo os seus clãs: de Gérson, o clã dos gersonitas; de Coate, o clã dos coatitas; de Merari, o clã dos meraritas.
pt.B: Estes foram os levitas recenseados segundo os seus clãs: de Gérson, o clã dos gersonitas; de Coate, o clã dos coatitas; e de Merari, o clã dos meraritas.
pt.R: Estes são os levitas que foram contados, segundo os seus clãs: o clã de Gérson, os gersonitas; o clã de Coate, os coatitas; e o clã de Merari, os meraritas.

decisions.choice: the Levites: counted apart, as in chapter 3
decisions.reason: Levi was not counted with the other tribes (1:47-49). Its three clans, named after Levi's three sons, are those of 3:17 and Exodus 6:16. The Levites' own total follows in verse 62.

source.text: אֵ֣לֶּה׀מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת לֵוִ֗י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת הַלִּבְנִ֜י מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽחֶבְרֹנִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַמַּחְלִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַקָּרְחִ֑י וּקְהָ֖ת הוֹלִ֥ד אֶת־עַמְרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: These [are the] clans of Levi: [the] clan of the Libnite, [the] clan of the Hebronite, [the] clan of the Mahlite, [the] clan of the Mushite, [the] clan of the Korahite. And Kohath fathered Amram.

en.L: These [are] the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnites, the clan of the Hebronites, the clan of the Mahlites, the clan of the Mushites, the clan of the Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.
en.B: These were the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnites, the clan of the Hebronites, the clan of the Mahlites, the clan of the Mushites and the clan of the Korahites. Kohath was the father of Amram.
en.R: The Levite clans were the Libnites, the Hebronites, the Mahlites, the Mushites and the Korahites. Kohath was Amram's father.

es.L: Estos [son] los clanes de Leví: el clan de los libnitas, el clan de los hebronitas, el clan de los majlitas, el clan de los musitas, el clan de los coreítas. Y Coat engendró a Amram.
es.B: Estos fueron los clanes de Leví: el clan de los libnitas, el clan de los hebronitas, el clan de los majlitas, el clan de los musitas y el clan de los coreítas. Coat fue el padre de Amram.
es.R: Los clanes levitas eran los libnitas, los hebronitas, los majlitas, los musitas y los coreítas. Coat era el padre de Amram.

fr.L: Ce [sont] là les clans de Lévi : le clan des Libnites, le clan des Hébronites, le clan des Mahlites, le clan des Moushites, le clan des Corites. Et Kehath engendra Amram.
fr.B: Tels furent les clans de Lévi : le clan des Libnites, le clan des Hébronites, le clan des Mahlites, le clan des Moushites et le clan des Corites. Kehath fut le père d’Amram.
fr.R: Les clans lévites étaient les Libnites, les Hébronites, les Mahlites, les Moushites et les Corites. Kehath était le père d’Amram.

sw.L: Hizi [ndizo] koo za Lawi: ukoo wa Walibni, ukoo wa Wahebroni, ukoo wa Wamahli, ukoo wa Wamushi, ukoo wa Wakora. Na Kohathi akamzaa Amramu.
sw.B: Hizi ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Lawi: ukoo wa Walibni, ukoo wa Wahebroni, ukoo wa Wamahli, ukoo wa Wamushi na ukoo wa Wakora. Kohathi alikuwa baba wa Amramu.
sw.R: Koo za Walawi zilikuwa Walibni, Wahebroni, Wamahli, Wamushi na Wakora. Kohathi alikuwa baba yake Amramu.

vi.L: Đây [là] các gia tộc Lê-vi: gia tộc Líp-ni, gia tộc Hếp-rôn, gia tộc Mách-li, gia tộc Mu-si, gia tộc Cô-rê. Và Kê-hát sinh Am-ram.
vi.B: Đây là các gia tộc Lê-vi: gia tộc Líp-ni, gia tộc Hếp-rôn, gia tộc Mách-li, gia tộc Mu-si và gia tộc Cô-rê. Kê-hát là cha của Am-ram.
vi.R: Các gia tộc Lê-vi là gia tộc Líp-ni, gia tộc Hếp-rôn, gia tộc Mách-li, gia tộc Mu-si và gia tộc Cô-rê. Kê-hát là cha của Am-ram.

ko.L: 이들이 레위의 가문들이다. 립니 사람들의 가문, 헤브론 사람들의 가문, 마흘리 사람들의 가문, 무시 사람들의 가문, 고라 사람들의 가문. 그리고 그핫이 아므람을 낳았다.
ko.B: 레위의 가문들은 립니 가문, 헤브론 가문, 마흘리 가문, 무시 가문, 고라 가문이었다. 그핫은 아므람의 아버지였다.
ko.R: 레위 지파의 가문들은 립니, 헤브론, 마흘리, 무시, 고라 가문이었다. 그핫은 아므람의 아버지였다.

pt.L: Estes [são] os clãs de Levi: o clã dos libnitas, o clã dos hebronitas, o clã dos malitas, o clã dos musitas, o clã dos coraítas. E Coate gerou Anrão.
pt.B: Esses foram os clãs de Levi: o clã dos libnitas, o clã dos hebronitas, o clã dos malitas, o clã dos musitas e o clã dos coraítas. Coate foi o pai de Anrão.
pt.R: Os clãs levitas eram os libnitas, os hebronitas, os malitas, os musitas e os coraítas. Coate foi o pai de Anrão.

decisions.choice: five clans of Levi: a second list beside verse 57
decisions.reason: These clans come from Levi's grandsons and great-grandsons: Libni from Gershon, Hebron from Kohath, Mahli and Mushi from Merari (3:18-20), and Korah from Kohath through Izhar (16:1; Exodus 6:21). The list is not arranged under the three sons, and some clans of chapter 3, such as the Shimeites and Amramites, are missing. It may be an older list of Levite clans.

decisions.choice: the Korahites: the line of Korah that survived
decisions.reason: This is the clan of the sons of Korah, who did not die with their father (verse 11).

decisions.choice: Kohath fathered Amram: a link to Moses' family
decisions.reason: The list turns from the clans to the family of Moses and Aaron, the line of the priests (verses 59-61). Amram was a son of Kohath (Exodus 6:18).

decisions.choice: os coraítas
decisions.reason: The Levite clans keep the names set at 3:21 (libnitas, hebronitas, malitas, musitas). The clan of Korah's sons (m2) is "os coraítas", formed on "Corá" (Exodus 6:21; 16:1) like the other clan names, with the accent for the hiatus.

source.text: וְשֵׁ֣ם׀אֵ֣שֶׁת עַמְרָ֗ם יוֹכֶ֨בֶד֙ בַּת־לֵוִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֥ה אֹתָ֛הּ לְלֵוִ֖י בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּ֣לֶד לְעַמְרָ֗ם אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֵ֖ת מִרְיָ֥ם אֲחֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] name of [the] wife of Amram: Jochebed daughter of Levi, whom bore her to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister.

en.L: And the name of the wife of Amram [was] Jochebed daughter of Levi, whom [one] bore to Levi in Egypt; and she bore to Amram Aaron and Moses and Miriam their sister.
en.B: Amram's wife was named Jochebed. She was a daughter of Levi, born to Levi in Egypt. To Amram she bore Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.
en.R: Amram's wife was Jochebed. She was a daughter of Levi, born to him in Egypt. She and Amram had three children: Aaron, Moses and their sister Miriam.

es.L: Y el nombre de la mujer de Amram [era] Jocabed, hija de Leví, a quien [su madre] dio a luz para Leví en Egipto; y ella dio a luz para Amram a Aarón, y a Moisés, y a Miriam, su hermana.
es.B: La mujer de Amram se llamaba Jocabed. Era una hija que le nació a Leví en Egipto. A Amram le dio a Aarón, a Moisés y a su hermana Miriam.
es.R: La mujer de Amram era Jocabed. Era hija de Leví y nació en Egipto. Ella y Amram tuvieron tres hijos: Aarón, Moisés y su hermana Miriam.

fr.L: Et le nom de la femme d’Amram [était] Jokébed, fille de Lévi, que [sa mère] enfanta à Lévi en Égypte ; et elle enfanta à Amram Aaron, et Moïse, et Myriam leur sœur.
fr.B: La femme d’Amram s’appelait Jokébed. C’était une fille de Lévi, qui lui était née en Égypte. Elle donna à Amram Aaron, Moïse et leur sœur Myriam.
fr.R: La femme d’Amram était Jokébed. C’était une fille que Lévi avait eue en Égypte. Amram et elle ont eu trois enfants : Aaron, Moïse et leur sœur Myriam.

sw.L: Na jina la mke wa Amramu [lilikuwa] Yokebedi binti wa Lawi, ambaye [mama yake] alimzalia Lawi katika Misri; naye akamzalia Amramu Haruni, na Musa, na Miriamu dada yao.
sw.B: Mke wa Amramu aliitwa Yokebedi. Alikuwa binti wa Lawi, aliyezaliwa kwa Lawi huko Misri. Alimzalia Amramu Haruni, Musa na dada yao Miriamu.
sw.R: Mke wa Amramu alikuwa Yokebedi. Alikuwa binti wa Lawi, aliyezaliwa Misri. Yeye na Amramu walipata watoto watatu: Haruni, Musa na dada yao Miriamu.

vi.L: Và tên vợ Am-ram [là] Giô-kê-bết con gái Lê-vi, là người [được] sinh cho Lê-vi tại Ai Cập; và bà sinh cho Am-ram A-rôn, Môi-se và Mi-ri-am, chị em của họ.
vi.B: Vợ Am-ram tên là Giô-kê-bết. Bà là con gái Lê-vi, sinh cho Lê-vi tại Ai Cập. Bà sinh cho Am-ram A-rôn, Môi-se và chị của họ là Mi-ri-am.
vi.R: Vợ của Am-ram là Giô-kê-bết. Bà là con gái của Lê-vi, sinh ra tại Ai Cập. Bà và Am-ram có ba người con: A-rôn, Môi-se và chị của họ là Mi-ri-am.

ko.L: 그리고 아므람의 아내의 이름은 요게벳으로, 레위의 딸이었다. [어떤 이가] 이집트에서 레위에게 그를 낳아 주었다. 그리고 그 여자가 아므람에게 아론과 모세와 그들의 누이 미리암을 낳아 주었다.
ko.B: 아므람의 아내의 이름은 요게벳이었다. 그 여자는 이집트에서 레위에게서 태어난 레위의 딸이었다. 요게벳은 아므람에게서 아론과 모세와 그들의 누이 미리암을 낳았다.
ko.R: 아므람의 아내는 요게벳이었다. 요게벳은 레위의 딸로, 이집트에서 태어났다. 요게벳과 아므람 사이에서 아론과 모세와 그들의 누이 미리암, 이렇게 세 자녀가 태어났다.

pt.L: E o nome da mulher de Anrão [era] Joquebede, filha de Levi, que [lhe] nasceu a Levi no Egito; e ela deu à luz para Anrão Arão, e Moisés, e Miriã, a irmã deles.
pt.B: A mulher de Anrão se chamava Joquebede. Ela era filha de Levi e lhe nasceu no Egito. Ela deu a Anrão os filhos Arão e Moisés e a irmã deles, Miriã.
pt.R: A mulher de Anrão era Joquebede. Ela era filha de Levi e nasceu no Egito. Ela e Anrão tiveram três filhos: Arão, Moisés e a irmã deles, Miriã.

decisions.choice: Jochebed daughter of Levi: the mother of Moses
decisions.reason: Exodus 6:20 names Jochebed as the wife of Amram and his father's sister, so she was Kohath's sister. Exodus 2:1 tells of the marriage of "a man of the house of Levi" and "a daughter of Levi", and of the birth of Moses.

decisions.choice: whom she bore to Levi: the mother is not named
decisions.reason: The verb is feminine, "she bore", with no subject. It means Jochebed's mother, whose name is not given; the sense is "who was born to Levi".

decisions.choice: in Egypt: born after Jacob's family went down
decisions.reason: Jochebed is the one member of this family said to be born in Egypt; Levi and his sons came there from Canaan (Genesis 46:11).

decisions.choice: had three children
decisions.reason: Readable puts "she bore to Amram" as "she and Amram had three children" and gives the number, which the list makes plain.

decisions.choice: "chị của họ" (their older sister) for Miriam at Balanced and Readable; Literal "chị em của họ"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese must say older or younger: Miriam is usually taken to be the sister who watched over the baby Moses (Exodus 2:4), so older than Moses; Literal keeps the neutral "chị em".

decisions.choice: que [lhe] nasceu a Levi (L)
alternatives: que [ela] deu à luz a Levi
decisions.reason: The verb "she bore" has no subject, and the mother is not named (m2). Literal says "que nasceu a Levi", the sense the meaning note gives, rather than a "she" that Portuguese would read as Jochebed herself. The names follow Exodus 6:20: Anrão, Joquebede, Miriã.

source.text: וַיִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶת־נָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֲבִיה֑וּא אֶת־אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאֶת־אִיתָמָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And was born to Aaron Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

en.L: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
en.B: Aaron became the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
en.R: Aaron's sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

es.L: Y a Aarón le nacieron Nadab y Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
es.B: Aarón fue padre de Nadab, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
es.R: Los hijos de Aarón eran Nadab, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

fr.L: Et à Aaron naquirent Nadab et Abihou, Éléazar et Ithamar.
fr.B: Aaron devint le père de Nadab, d’Abihou, d’Éléazar et d’Ithamar.
fr.R: Les fils d’Aaron étaient Nadab, Abihou, Éléazar et Ithamar.

sw.L: Na kwa Haruni wakazaliwa Nadabu na Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
sw.B: Haruni aliwazaa Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.
sw.R: Wana wa Haruni walikuwa Nadabu, Abihu, Eleazari na Ithamari.

vi.L: Và cho A-rôn được sinh ra Na-đáp và A-bi-hu, Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma.
vi.B: A-rôn là cha của Na-đáp, A-bi-hu, Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma.
vi.R: Các con trai A-rôn là Na-đáp, A-bi-hu, Ê-lê-a-sa và Y-tha-ma.

ko.L: 그리고 아론에게서 나답과 아비후, 엘르아살과 이다말이 태어났다.
ko.B: 아론은 나답과 아비후와 엘르아살과 이다말을 낳았다.
ko.R: 아론의 아들들은 나답, 아비후, 엘르아살, 이다말이었다.

pt.L: E a Arão nasceram Nadabe e Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
pt.B: Arão foi o pai de Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
pt.R: Os filhos de Arão foram Nadabe, Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.

decisions.choice: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar: Aaron's sons, the first priests
decisions.reason: As in 3:2 and Exodus 6:23. Eleazar is now the high priest who takes this census with Moses (verse 1).

decisions.choice: was born: a singular verb for four names
decisions.reason: The verb is singular, "there was born", though four sons follow. Hebrew can use a singular verb ahead of a list of subjects; the sense is not affected.

source.text: וַיָּ֥מָת נָדָ֖ב וַאֲבִיה֑וּא בְּהַקְרִיבָ֥ם אֵשׁ־זָרָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And died Nadab and Abihu when they brought near fire strange before Yahweh.

en.L: And Nadab and Abihu died when they brought near strange fire before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered an improper fire before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the wrong kind of fire.

es.L: Y murieron Nadab y Abiú cuando ofrecieron fuego extraño delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero Nadab y Abiú murieron cuando ofrecieron un fuego no autorizado delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero Nadab y Abiú murieron cuando le ofrecieron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} un fuego que no era el correcto.

fr.L: Et Nadab et Abihou moururent quand ils présentèrent un feu étranger devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais Nadab et Abihou moururent lorsqu’ils offrirent un feu non autorisé devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais Nadab et Abihou sont morts quand ils ont offert {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un feu qui n’était pas le bon.

sw.L: Na Nadabu na Abihu wakafa walipoleta moto wa kigeni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa walipotoa moto usioruhusiwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini Nadabu na Abihu walikufa walipomtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} moto ambao haukuwa moto unaofaa.

vi.L: Và Na-đáp và A-bi-hu chết khi họ dâng lửa lạ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nhưng Na-đáp và A-bi-hu đã chết khi dâng lửa không hợp lệ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhưng Na-đáp và A-bi-hu đã chết khi dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thứ lửa không đúng.

ko.L: 그리고 나답과 아비후는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 낯선 불을 가까이 드렸을 때 죽었다.
ko.B: 그러나 나답과 아비후는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 합당하지 않은 불을 드렸다가 죽었다.
ko.R: 그러나 나답과 아비후는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 잘못된 불을 드렸다가 죽었다.

pt.L: E Nadabe e Abiú morreram quando apresentaram fogo estranho diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram quando ofereceram um fogo não autorizado diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram quando ofereceram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} um fogo que não era o certo.

decisions.choice: strange fire: the fire of Leviticus 10:1-2
decisions.reason: As in 3:4. Nadab and Abihu offered fire the LORD had not commanded, and fire came from the LORD and consumed them (Leviticus 10:1-2). "Strange" means not authorized; the exact fault is not explained.

decisions.choice: strange fire / an improper fire / the wrong kind of fire
decisions.reason: As in 3:4.

source.text: וַיִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵיהֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כָּל־זָכָ֖ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה כִּ֣י׀לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּתוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא־נִתַּ֤ן לָהֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And were their enrolled [men] three and twenty thousand, every male from a son of a month and upward; for not they were enrolled in [the] midst of [the] sons of Israel, for not was given to them inheritance in [the] midst of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And those of them enrolled were 23,000, every male from a son of a month and upward; for they were not enrolled among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, because no inheritance was given to them among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel.
en.B: The Levites enrolled numbered 23,000, every male one month old and up. They were not enrolled with the other {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, because they were given no inheritance among them.
en.R: There were 23,000 Levite boys and men who were at least one month old. They were not counted with the other {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, because they were not given any land of their own.

es.L: Y fueron sus alistados 23 000, todo varón desde [la edad de] un mes en adelante; porque no fueron alistados en medio de los hijos de Israel, porque no se les dio herencia en medio de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Los levitas alistados fueron 23 000, todos los varones de un mes o más. No fueron alistados con los demás israelitas, porque no se les dio herencia entre ellos.
es.R: Había 23 000 niños y hombres levitas de por lo menos un mes. No los contaron con los demás israelitas, porque no recibieron tierra propia.

fr.L: Et leurs recensés furent 23 000, tout mâle depuis [l’âge d’]un mois et au-dessus ; car ils ne furent pas recensés au milieu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, parce qu’il ne leur fut pas donné d’héritage au milieu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël.
fr.B: Les Lévites recensés furent au nombre de 23 000, tous les garçons et les hommes âgés d’un mois et plus. Ils ne furent pas recensés avec les autres {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, parce qu’il ne leur fut pas donné d’héritage parmi eux.
fr.R: On a compté 23 000 garçons et hommes lévites âgés d’au moins un mois. On ne les a pas comptés avec les autres {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, parce qu’ils n’avaient pas reçu de terre à eux.

sw.L: Na walioandikishwa wao walikuwa 23,000, kila wa kiume kuanzia mwana wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi; kwa maana hawakuandikishwa katikati ya wana wa Israeli, kwa sababu hawakupewa urithi katikati ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Walawi walioandikishwa walikuwa 23,000, kila wa kiume mwenye umri wa mwezi mmoja na zaidi. Hawakuandikishwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine, kwa sababu hawakupewa urithi miongoni mwao.
sw.R: Walikuwako wavulana na wanaume Walawi 23,000 wenye angalau mwezi mmoja. Hawakuhesabiwa pamoja na Waisraeli wengine, kwa sababu hawakupewa nchi yao wenyewe.

vi.L: Và những người được kiểm kê của họ là 23.000, mọi người nam từ [đứa trẻ] một tháng trở lên; vì họ không được kiểm kê giữa con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, bởi vì không có sản nghiệp nào được ban cho họ giữa con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Số người Lê-vi được kiểm kê là 23.000, gồm mọi người nam từ một tháng trở lên. Họ không được kiểm kê chung với các người Y-sơ-ra-ên khác, vì họ không được ban sản nghiệp giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Có 23.000 người Lê-vi, kể cả các bé trai và đàn ông, từ một tháng tuổi trở lên. Họ không được đếm chung với những người Y-sơ-ra-ên khác, vì họ không được chia đất riêng.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 가운데 계수된 자는 23,000[명으로], 한 달 된 아들부터 그 이상의 모든 남자였다. 그들은 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 계수되지 않았으니, 이스라엘 자손 가운데서 그들에게 유산이 주어지지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 계수된 레위인은 한 달 이상 된 남자가 모두 23,000명이었다. 그들은 다른 이스라엘 백성과 함께 계수되지 않았다. 그들에게는 이스라엘 백성 가운데서 유산이 주어지지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.R: 한 달 이상 된 레위인 남자아이와 남자는 23,000명이었다. 그들은 다른 이스라엘 사람들과 함께 세지 않았다. 그들은 자기 땅을 받지 않았기 때문이다.

pt.L: E os recenseados deles foram 23.000, todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima; porque não foram recenseados no meio dos filhos de Israel, porque não lhes foi dada herança no meio dos filhos de Israel.
pt.B: O número dos levitas recenseados foi 23.000, todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima. Eles não foram recenseados com os outros israelitas, porque não receberam herança entre eles.
pt.R: Havia 23.000 meninos e homens levitas de pelo menos um mês de idade. Eles não foram contados com os outros israelitas, porque não receberam nenhuma terra para eles.

decisions.choice: 23,000 males from one month old: counted as in chapter 3
decisions.reason: As in 3:15 and 3:39, the Levites are counted from one month old, not from twenty, because they are not counted for war. The first count gave 22,000 (3:39). On the size of the numbers, see the note at 1:21.

decisions.choice: no inheritance was given to them: the LORD is their share
decisions.reason: The Levites receive no tribal land, because the LORD himself is their share, and they live from the tithes Israel gives (18:20-24). They are given towns to live in among the other tribes (35:1-8). Since this census was taken to divide the land (verses 53-54), they are counted apart.

decisions.choice: were not enrolled: the rare passive form of 1:47
decisions.reason: The verb is the unusual passive form used of the Levites in 1:47. The sense is plain: they were not entered in this count.

decisions.choice: the other Israelites
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the other" Israelites, since the Levites were Israelites too, as in 2:33.

decisions.choice: todos os do sexo masculino de um mês para cima (L, B); meninos e homens (R)
decisions.reason: As 3:15 sets it for the Levite counts: those counted include babies (m1), so "homem" would be wrong; the words of 3:22 and 3:39 are kept at each level.

source.text: אֵ֚לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: These [are the] enrolled of Moses and Eleazar the priest, who enrolled [the] sons of Israel in [the] plains of Moab by [the] Jordan of Jericho.

en.L: These [are] those enrolled by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who enrolled the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan [at] Jericho.
en.B: These are the ones enrolled by Moses and Eleazar the priest when they enrolled the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, across from Jericho.
en.R: These are the ones Moses and Eleazar the priest counted. They counted the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} on the plains of Moab, beside the Jordan River across from Jericho.

es.L: Estos [son] los alistados por Moisés y Eleazar el sacerdote, que alistaron a los hijos de Israel en las llanuras de Moab, junto al Jordán [de] Jericó.
es.B: Estos son los que alistaron Moisés y el sacerdote Eleazar cuando alistaron a los israelitas en las llanuras de Moab, junto al Jordán, frente a Jericó.
es.R: Estos son los que contaron Moisés y el sacerdote Eleazar. Contaron a los israelitas en la llanura de Moab, junto al río Jordán, frente a Jericó.

fr.L: Ce [sont] là les recensés de Moïse et d’Éléazar le prêtre, qui recensèrent les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain [à] Jéricho.
fr.B: Tels sont ceux que recensèrent Moïse et le prêtre Éléazar, lorsqu’ils recensèrent les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, en face de Jéricho.
fr.R: Voilà ceux que Moïse et le prêtre Éléazar ont comptés. Ils ont compté les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} dans la plaine de Moab, au bord du fleuve Jourdain, en face de Jéricho.

sw.L: Hawa [ndio] walioandikishwa na Musa na Eleazari kuhani, waliowaandikisha wana wa Israeli katika nchi tambarare za Moabu karibu na Yordani [ya] Yeriko.
sw.B: Hawa ndio walioandikishwa na Musa na kuhani Eleazari walipowaandikisha Waisraeli katika nchi tambarare za Moabu karibu na Yordani, mkabala na Yeriko.
sw.R: Hawa ndio watu ambao Musa na kuhani Eleazari waliwahesabu. Waliwahesabu Waisraeli katika nchi tambarare ya Moabu, kando ya Mto Yordani, mkabala na Yeriko.

vi.L: Đây [là] những người được Môi-se và thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa kiểm kê, là những người đã kiểm kê con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên tại các đồng bằng Mô-áp, bên sông Giô-đanh [đối diện] Giê-ri-cô.
vi.B: Đó là những người được Môi-se và thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa kiểm kê khi họ kiểm tra dân số dân Y-sơ-ra-ên tại các đồng bằng Mô-áp, bên sông Giô-đanh, đối diện Giê-ri-cô.
vi.R: Đó là những người Môi-se và thầy tế lễ Ê-lê-a-sa đã đếm. Họ đếm dân Y-sơ-ra-ên tại vùng đồng bằng Mô-áp, bên sông Giô-đanh, đối diện thành Giê-ri-cô.

ko.L: 이들이 모세와 제사장 엘르아살이 계수한 자들이니, 그들이 여리고 [맞은편] 요단 가 모압 평지에서 이스라엘 자손을 계수하였다.
ko.B: 이들은 모세와 제사장 엘르아살이 요단강 가, 여리고 맞은편 모압 평지에서 이스라엘 백성을 계수할 때에 계수된 사람들이다.
ko.R: 이들은 모세와 제사장 엘르아살이 센 사람들이다. 그들은 요단강 가, 여리고 맞은편의 모압 평지에서 이스라엘 사람들을 세었다.

pt.L: Estes [são] os recenseados por Moisés e Eleazar, o sacerdote, que recensearam os filhos de Israel nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão [de] Jericó.
pt.B: Esses foram os recenseados por Moisés e pelo sacerdote Eleazar, quando recensearam os israelitas nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao Jordão, em frente a Jericó.
pt.R: Esses foram os homens que Moisés e o sacerdote Eleazar contaram. Eles contaram os israelitas nas planícies de Moabe, junto ao rio Jordão, em frente a Jericó.

decisions.choice: these are the enrolled of Moses and Eleazar: the closing summary
decisions.reason: The words close the census begun in verses 1-4, naming the same men and the same place (verse 3). Verses 64-65 then set this count beside the first.

decisions.choice: across from Jericho
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

source.text: וּבְאֵ֨לֶּה֙ לֹא־הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִפְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And among these not was a man of [the] enrolled of Moses and Aaron the priest, who enrolled [the] sons of Israel in [the] wilderness of Sinai.

en.L: And among these there was not a man of those enrolled by Moses and Aaron the priest, who enrolled the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
en.B: Among them there was not one man of those enrolled by Moses and Aaron the priest when they enrolled the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} in the wilderness of Sinai.
en.R: Not one of these men had been on the list that Moses and Aaron the priest made when they counted the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} in the Desert of Sinai.

es.L: Y entre estos no había un hombre de los alistados por Moisés y Aarón el sacerdote, que alistaron a los hijos de Israel en el desierto del Sinaí.
es.B: Entre ellos no había ni un solo hombre de los que Moisés y el sacerdote Aarón alistaron cuando alistaron a los israelitas en el desierto del Sinaí.
es.R: Ninguno de estos hombres había estado en la lista que hicieron Moisés y el sacerdote Aarón cuando contaron a los israelitas en el desierto del Sinaí.

fr.L: Et parmi ceux-ci il n’y avait pas un homme des recensés de Moïse et d’Aaron le prêtre, qui recensèrent les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël dans le désert du Sinaï.
fr.B: Parmi eux, il n’y avait pas un seul des hommes que Moïse et le prêtre Aaron avaient recensés lorsqu’ils recensèrent les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} dans le désert du Sinaï.
fr.R: Aucun de ces hommes n’était sur la liste que Moïse et le prêtre Aaron avaient faite quand ils avaient compté les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} dans le désert du Sinaï.

sw.L: Na miongoni mwa hawa hakuwamo mtu wa wale walioandikishwa na Musa na Haruni kuhani, waliowaandikisha wana wa Israeli katika nyika ya Sinai.
sw.B: Miongoni mwao hakuwamo hata mtu mmoja wa wale walioandikishwa na Musa na kuhani Haruni walipowaandikisha Waisraeli katika nyika ya Sinai.
sw.R: Hakuna hata mmoja wa wanaume hawa aliyekuwa kwenye orodha ambayo Musa na kuhani Haruni waliandika walipowahesabu Waisraeli katika jangwa la Sinai.

vi.L: Và trong những người này không có một người nào trong số những người được Môi-se và thầy tế lễ A-rôn kiểm kê, là những người đã kiểm kê con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên trong hoang mạc Si-na-i.
vi.B: Trong số họ không có một người nào thuộc số những người được Môi-se và thầy tế lễ A-rôn kiểm kê khi họ kiểm tra dân số dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trong hoang mạc Si-na-i.
vi.R: Không ai trong số những người này đã có tên trong danh sách mà Môi-se và thầy tế lễ A-rôn lập khi họ đếm dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trong hoang mạc Si-na-i.

ko.L: 그리고 이들 가운데에는 모세와 제사장 아론이 시내 광야에서 이스라엘 자손을 계수할 때 계수된 자가 한 사람도 없었다.
ko.B: 이들 가운데에는 모세와 제사장 아론이 시내 광야에서 이스라엘 백성을 계수할 때 계수된 사람이 하나도 없었다.
ko.R: 이들 가운데에는 모세와 제사장 아론이 시내 광야에서 이스라엘 사람들을 셀 때 명단에 올랐던 사람이 하나도 없었다.

pt.L: E entre estes não havia um homem dos recenseados por Moisés e Arão, o sacerdote, que recensearam os filhos de Israel no deserto do Sinai.
pt.B: Entre eles não havia nem um só homem dos que tinham sido recenseados por Moisés e pelo sacerdote Arão, quando recensearam os israelitas no deserto do Sinai.
pt.R: Nenhum desses homens estava na lista que Moisés e o sacerdote Arão fizeram quando contaram os israelitas no deserto do Sinai.

decisions.choice: the enrolled of Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai: the first census
decisions.reason: This looks back to the census of chapter 1, taken at Sinai in the second year after the exodus (1:1-3, 19). None of the men counted then are counted now: a new generation has grown up.

decisions.choice: a man: none of the men twenty years old and up
decisions.reason: The words concern the men counted for war, from twenty years old up (1:3; 14:29). The Levites and the women were not part of that count.

decisions.choice: the Desert of Sinai
decisions.reason: Readable says "desert" for "wilderness", as in 1:1.
